Files the tests read. The invoice is made up: no real business's document
is kept in this repository.

- invoice-reading.json   what Claude returns for the invoice photo
- invoice-misread.json   a first reading with one digit misread (122.50 as
                         112.50), so the lines miss the printed total and the
                         dashboard asks for a second look
- fourteen-months.csv    fourteen made-up months (Sep 2025 to Oct 2026) with Total costs and
                         Net profit columns, which must be set aside rather than counted twice
